title: R5-01: P0 / H runtime + integration: queued-session startup (org limit 3), deterministic pre-payment checkpoints with force_answer (P11), gateway-city verification + fragment-preserving start URLs (P12), redirect diagnostics, Njuko scrub fixes, R5 docs/queue/owner feedback, final 3-agent live acceptance
spec: Root causes verified by the planner (2026-11-09): (i) the H org quota is limit=3 concurrent sessions (GET /api/v2/sessions/quota -> {scope:org,limit:3}); above it H returns 201 status `queued`, but hclient starts its 45 s 'no reviewed page yet' deadline at create time, so queued sessions are killed as provider_error 'Browser startup unavailable' (R4 P0-5, and any P7 alternative/retry while 3 sessions run). (ii) Every started H run ends step_limit: hclient raises _StepLimit at metrics.steps>=max_steps without ever asking the agent to answer, even when the observed URL is already the safe pre-payment page (IHG select-enhance-stay / pay, Njuko currentPage=form_individual-form). H exposes POST /sessions/{id}/force_answer (agent answers from its current context on the next step; docs hub.hcompany.ai/agents-api/sessions/force-answer.md) and POST /sessions/{id}/messages. (iii) unreviewed_redirect keeps no diagnostic, so Vueling's redirect target is unknown. (iv) gateway transport (Den Haag via Amsterdam) cannot verify because city matching is a substring of expected.city; hclient strips URL fragments (NS International #/ routes). (v) scrub_url rejects real Njuko URLs with phone-like numeric or hex /w/<id> segments (Geneva, Den Haag widget). IMPLEMENT in hclient.py: 1) Queue-aware startup: read session status from create/changes; while status is `queued` or `pending` do not run the 45 s/3-blank deadline; emit one friendly step_progress 'En attente d'un navigateur disponible' (honest, no counts); start the 45 s deadline and the per-agent 10-minute budget when status becomes `running`; cap total queue wait at 8 minutes then blocked provider_error. Send an Idempotency-Key header on create (and on the pre-progress retry use a new key). Never print keys. 2) P11 checkpoints (new pinned interface, document in CONTRACTS.md): a task (and each P7 alternative) may carry `checkpoint: {url_patterns: [regex], beyond_patterns: [regex]}` (patterns matched case-insensitively against unquoted path+'?'+query of the reviewed observed URL; invalid regex/types -> ignore checkpoint, fail closed for READY). When a reviewed observation matches url_patterns: emit its frame, POST /sessions/{id}/force_answer once, keep polling up to 60 s for the answer, then evaluate with the existing _verified (handoff must equal the checkpoint URL). When an observation matches beyond_patterns (guest/passenger details, /pay, payment) it is a hard boundary: cancel the session immediately and return blocked with reason_code `policy_denied` (or `unsafe_claim` if the agent's answer claims a booking/payment), handoff = last observed reviewed checkpoint URL if any, else the existing fallback rules; never READY. Step budget: at steps >= max_steps-3 (and on H error_code step_limit if the session still accepts commands) call force_answer once and wait <=45 s before raising _StepLimit; a verified answer can still be READY only if the final observed URL matches the task checkpoint (when present). Include `checkpoint` patterns in the prompt only as 'stop page' hints, never raw regex to the UI. Tasks without checkpoint keep current behaviour. 3) P12 (document in CONTRACTS.md): `expected.gateway_city` optional string for hotel/transport; when present, verification `city` may match either expected.city or gateway_city (exact normalized equality or substring as today), never any other city. Task key `keep_fragment: true` keeps the start_url fragment if scrub_url(start_url) is unchanged and the policy review of the fragment-less URL is allowed; otherwise strip as now. 4) Redirect diagnostics: on unreviewed_redirect record the scrubbed host+path (no query/fragment) of the offending URL in a new optional StepResult field `blocked_url_host` (models.py, additive, validated public host/path only, never shown raw in the UI copy) and in step logs; non-http(s) browser-internal URLs (about:*, chrome:*, chrome-error:*, data:, blob:, empty) are treated like about:blank (skipped, same limits), never as redirects. 5) scrub.py: accept Njuko-style path segments (`/<slug>-2027-<13 digit id>`, `/w/<hex id>`) while still redacting phone numbers in query values/text, emails, tokens; add regression tests with the real Geneva/Den Haag shapes and with true phone/email cases. 6) Frames: keep only genuine observation images; additionally emit friendly step_progress 'Étape N' (from metrics.steps, monotonic) so the UI can show honest activity between frames. 7) Core: providers.LiveRunner/app keep launching 3 kinds concurrently (no serialization); mission result for queued-then-running agents unchanged. 8) Docs (this ticket alone owns shared docs): R5 queue in docs/tickets/index.json + docs/tickets/R5-0x.md (copy each R5 ticket spec + exact Allowed files), replace tests/test_r4_scope_contract.py by tests/test_r5_scope_contract.py (same checks for R5-01..R5-05, CONTRACTS markers P11/checkpoint/force_answer/P12/gateway_city), update AGENTS.md/PLAN.md/README.md/HANDOFF.md to the R5 queue (no stale Milan-only/frozen journey wording anywhere; Milan is one eval case), add a '## Round 5' section at the TOP of docs/feedback/owner.md that records verbatim the owner hands-on feedback (a)-(d) (ChatGPT-style suggestion pills under the reply; each new question BELOW the latest proposals; after launch keep 3 agent cards and below ONLY the agents acting live, never raw task/prompt/JSON/logs; immediate streaming/typing feedback; 'fully functional, beautiful, near-perfect site by morning'), the Strava design priority, the exact live-success definition, the adversarial requirement and the site-policy rules (Accor denied). 9) PR-A merges as soon as green. PR-B (rebased after R5-02..R5-05 merge): >=5 UI-driven live cases run ONE MISSION AT A TIME (quota 3), assistant-proposed races: Milan marathon, Amsterdam/Bijlmer 10K or NN CPC Den Haag, Barcelona/Valencia/Seville, a Swiss trail, Lisbon/Porto; default Paris + one Lyon/Bruxelles/Genève origin; record per agent: H started, queued time, frames, max gap, final reason_code, checkpoint reached y/n, READY y/n, in docs/eval/round-5-acceptance.md (no H screenshots committed). Target >=1 complete 3/3 success; never claim one that is not observed. COMMON RULES: branch from current main (9fc8389 or later), one ticket = one branch = one PR; touch ONLY the listed files (request a scope amendment otherwise); import sibling modules lazily and fail closed when missing; CI never calls live providers; write docs/handoff/<id>.md with changes, pasted check output, dated scrubbed live evidence, blockers, next steps. Never pay/book/create accounts/accept terms or consent/submit forms/enter personal data/bypass captchas; Accor and prohibited entries stay denied; unknown/expired reviews block before any H session; H frames are in_session_only (never commit H/site screenshots, private H URLs or session ids). H ORG CONCURRENCY LIMIT IS 3 SESSIONS shared by all R5 implementers: check GET https://agp.eu.hcompany.ai/api/v2/sessions/quota (available>0) before a live smoke and run at most one H session at a time per ticket (except R5-01 PR-B). Keys only via env (HAI_API_KEY, LINKUP_API_KEY, GLADIA_API_KEY), never printed. Squash-merge yourself only with green CI (use `command gh pr merge N --squash --match-head-commit SHA`).

Behavioral (offline fakes): a session that stays `queued` 120 s then runs and reaches a reviewed page is NOT provider_error and emits 'En attente d'un navigateur disponible' once; a queued session >8 min ends blocked provider_error; an observation matching checkpoint.url_patterns triggers exactly one POST /force_answer and a verified answer yields ready_for_payment with handoff == checkpoint URL; an observation matching beyond_patterns stops the session (cancel called) and never yields READY; reaching max_steps-3 calls force_answer before step_limit; a READY answer whose final URL does not match a present checkpoint stays blocked; gateway_city lets transport verify 'Amsterdam' for a Den Haag race and still rejects 'Rotterdam'; keep_fragment preserves '#/...' only when policy allows; unreviewed_redirect results carry blocked_url_host (host/path only, no query) and about:/chrome-error: observations are skipped; Njuko Geneva and /w/<hex> URLs survive scrub_url while phone/email are still redacted; tasks without checkpoint behave as before (all existing hclient tests pass). Live: PR-B report docs/eval/round-5-acceptance.md with >=5 cases run sequentially, honest per-agent stop states, >=1 case where all 3 agents start (no provider_error) with changing frames.

title: R5-04: P0 guide: no dead-end loops, deterministic named races (bare 'le marathon de Milan', Berlin), correct mind/origin changes, propose only preparable open races first, dedupe, FR city names, adversarial suite >=130 incl. all R4 A01-A16 regressions
spec: Round-4 failures to fix (live Linkup): (1) dead-end loops: Barcelona unverified card + only chip 'Try again' returned the identical card 10x; Portugal Funchal<->EDP unverified ping-pong 10x; Lyon 'En Suisse' chip returned the identical 'no race' reply 10x. Rule: no assistant turn may repeat the previous turn's message+candidates+chips; a retry must change the query (deeper depth, named-race query, neighbouring months, same country other city) and after one failed retry offer verified (official-date) alternatives or other concrete chips; static no-result chips ('En Suisse', 'En juillet', 'Un marathon') must actually re-search with that constraint merged into the intent. Unverified-date candidates are never the only recommendation when an official alternative exists. (2) Bare 'le marathon de Milan' / 'marathon de Milan' / 'Milano marathon' must find the same race as 'J'aimerais faire le marathon de Milan' (named-race intent + deterministic normalization + cache key); same for 'marathon de Berlin' after a mind change (A03). (3) Origin handling: at origin stage a bare city ('Paris') is the origin, never a race search (A08); 'non en fait de Bruxelles' / 'je pars de X' / 'départ de X' / 'from X' are origin corrections at ANY stage, never a destination (A16); an explicit origin inside the first request ('un 10 km aux Pays-Bas, départ de Bruxelles') sets origin and still searches the destination country. (4) Proposals: rank fully preparable+open (P9 registration covered/open and hotel+transport True from current origin) first; sold-out/closed editions never primary (label 'complet (liste d'attente)'); dedupe candidates by normalized name+date (Rome x2, Descobrimentos x2); when the user delegates or the top candidate is unpreparable, explicitly say what can be prepared. (5) Off-topic ('météo demain', poems) -> polite one-sentence refocus, never 'pas d'événement sourcé pour demain'. (6) Germany marathon search must surface sourced Berlin/Frankfurt/Hamburg editions when Linkup has them (country-level query templates incl. 'marathon Allemagne 2027 date officielle'); never invent. (7) Localize city/country names in turns/draft display to the conversation language (FR: Genève, Milan, Lisbonne, Barcelone, La Haye; EN: Geneva...) without changing the trip dict fields used by builders (keep canonical city for builders). (8) Keep first reply fast (p50 <= 10 s live) and the cache; keep P9 preparation display-only.
